stations.title: POST /quotes
stations.text: Wired up, but cannot read a body.

captions: The fleet list works. Now Luka wants a price for a double for three hours.
The quote route is wired, but nothing reads what the page sends.
You write the part that reads and checks the body, in three tasks.
Now a good request gets its price, and a broken one gets a clear 400.
Same request, a real price. Bad input is refused, not trusted.
